build_check_limitation_tsc: tsc --noEmit -p with the project's tsconfig.json; a component without a tsconfig.json is not checked, and project references (tsc -b) are not built.
build_check_limitation_mypy: mypy with the project's own configuration; a Python component without a mypy configuration is not checked. mypy plugins named in the configuration run project code.
build_check_limitation_pyright: pyright with the project's own configuration; a Python component without a pyright configuration is not checked. The pyright wrapper from pip may download its Node package on first use.
build_check_limitation_go: go build ./... then go vet ./... (vet runs only when the build is clean); the run uses no network (GOPROXY=off) and never downloads a toolchain.
build_check_limitation_cargo: cargo check --offline for the default targets; build scripts and procedural macros of the project run. Warnings are non-blocking findings.
build_check_limitation_dotnet: dotnet build of the project file of each component; analyzers and MSBuild targets of the project run, and bin/ and obj/ are written next to the project.
